description: What the Continuum can do, and which of it needs an external provider. Provider requirement is a property of the capability, never of how hard a task is. This registry is the Brain-side counterpart of app/provider_reservoir/capabilities.py in orchid-calyx-backend; the two must agree, and a deterministic test on each side checks that they do.

capabilities.name: taxonomy-resolution
capabilities.summary: Resolve a name against the canonical taxonomy tables.

capabilities.name: literature-evidence-lookup
capabilities.summary: Retrieve stored literature records and their provenance.

capabilities.name: interaction-kg-lookup
capabilities.summary: Retrieve stored interaction and knowledge-graph edges.

capabilities.name: geospatial-context
capabilities.summary: Assemble bounded environmental and geographic context.

capabilities.name: reasoning-map-assembly
capabilities.summary: Assemble an inspectable reasoning map from retrieved evidence.

capabilities.name: contradiction-detection
capabilities.summary: Compare retrieved claims and mark those that conflict.

capabilities.name: evidence-gap-detection
capabilities.summary: Mark what the retrieved evidence does not cover.

capabilities.name: provenance-assembly
capabilities.summary: Attach source and provenance to every retrieved claim.

capabilities.name: schema-validation
capabilities.summary: Validate an artifact against its declared schema.

capabilities.name: fixture-execution
capabilities.summary: Run a stored deterministic fixture and compare it to expectations.

capabilities.name: reconcile
capabilities.summary: Reconcile queue, lease and label state against durable receipts.

capabilities.name: test-execution
capabilities.summary: Run the repository's own test suites.

capabilities.name: lint-execution
capabilities.summary: Run the repository's own linters and formatters.

capabilities.name: locality-redaction
capabilities.summary: Withhold or generalise protected locality before anything leaves.

capabilities.name: natural-language-explanation
capabilities.summary: Render an assembled reasoning map into prose a non-specialist can follow.
capabilities.deterministic_alternative: The map, its evidence states and its gaps are assembled deterministically and can be presented as structured fields; only the connecting prose needs generation.

capabilities.name: free-text-intent-parsing
capabilities.summary: Interpret an arbitrary typed or spoken question into a structured intent.
capabilities.deterministic_alternative: A stored fixture covers the known question forms deterministically; only an unseen free-text phrasing needs generation.

capabilities.name: open-ended-code-authoring
capabilities.summary: Author a non-trivial implementation from a prose specification.
capabilities.deterministic_alternative: Templated and fixture-driven generation covers the repetitive cases; only genuinely novel implementation needs a model.

capabilities.name: literature-summarisation
capabilities.summary: Summarise a paper whose text is stored but whose summary is not.
capabilities.deterministic_alternative: Stored abstracts and extracted fields are served directly where present; only a paper with neither needs generation.
